title: A Cup of Water, Ten Days Long
story: Ten Days and a Cup of Water
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Far off in Babylon's great hall
The king's rich food was spread;
But Daniel kindly asked the man,
"Please give us greens instead."

[Chorus]
A cup of water, ten days long,
A quiet, faithful heart;
Small choices make a heart grow strong
And wise in every part.

[Verse 2]
"Just try it for ten days," he said,
"Then come and look at us."
They ate their greens and drank their cups
With no complaint or fuss.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
And when the tenth day came around,
Their faces shone so bright;
The Lord gave wisdom to the four
To learn and choose what's right.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Wren eats her apple slices first
And doesn't tell a soul;
One quiet choice, then one choice more,
She feels so strong and whole.

[Chorus]
mood: Counting music. A small celtic harp plucks a patient, even step, like days ticked off one at a time, with a low cello note held quietly underneath. It stays plain and close through the first verses, then the harp opens into wider rolled chords on the tenth-day verse, never louder, and the last chorus lands clear and steady, like a cool drink of water at noon.
